reason: Request amount may not exceed $1,000,000.00. sits in a plain div with no live ancestor (the page's only role=alert node is empty) while focus stays in the amount field. The field has aria-errormessage but no aria-invalid, so the tree exposes no invalid state or message either. A screen-reader user who submits 2,000,000 hears nothing and has to explore the page to learn why; the task is possible, and this is an error, not the confirmation of a money movement.
